caption: The string of a helium balloon tied to a park bench comes loose, and the balloon floats up into the sky.

sa.check: A helium balloon is tied by its string to a park bench.
The string comes loose from the bench.
The balloon floats up into the sky.
The string comes loose first and the rise follows.

pc.expect: The balloon stays by the bench while it is tied and starts to rise only once the string is free.
pc.fail: The balloon rises while its string is still tied to the bench; or it drifts off with the string never coming loose; or it hangs still above the bench long after coming free.

pc.expect: The balloon climbs with the string hanging beneath it, the loose end trailing as the lowest part.
pc.fail: The balloon drops to the ground once free; or it climbs with the string standing above it; or the string holds out straight sideways and stays there.

pc.expect: The rise is a steady drift upward that keeps going while the balloon is in view.
pc.fail: The balloon shoots upward like a thrown ball; or it stops in mid-air and hangs at bench height; or it reverses and comes back down.

pc.expect: The balloon stays a taut rounded shape and the string stays a limp line of fixed length.
pc.fail: The balloon deflates and keeps climbing; or the string goes rigid like a rod; or the string grows longer as the balloon climbs.

pc.expect: One balloon on one string keeps its shape and passes through nothing.
pc.fail: The balloon vanishes or a second one appears; or the string comes away from the balloon and the balloon goes on trailing it; or the balloon passes through a branch or through the bench.

pc.expect: The balloon's colour, the bench and the park stay the same.
pc.fail: The balloon changes colour as it rises; or the bench changes shape between frames; or the park behind rearranges.
